English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #fakenews Fake News about a new statue in Jaffna False The Jaffna Bishops House says that certain reports about a proposed installation of statue of “Pudumai Mata” behind Jaffna Cultural Center is false. by Anonymous | April 24, 2023 Responding to a query made by FactSeeker, Rev Fr PJ Jeparatnam of Jaffna Diocese stated that the pamphlet being distributed that a ceremony to install a “Pudumai Mata” statue will be held soon is fake. The statue will be inaugurated on 01st May by the Bishop of Jaffna, Justin Gnanapragasam, says the leaflet. Categorically rejecting all those reports, the Bishops House says no such event has been organised by the Church. Latest updates #misleading Did Sri Lankan MPs Receive a Rs. 60,000 Salary Increase? The objective and long-term goal of the FactSeeker is to provide the public with reliable and verified content in the attempt of debunking mis/disinformation. The unit, with the SLPI, is committed to contributing to improved media literacy in Sri Lanka.
